evidence.quote: This rate is well below the Committee's 2 percent longer-run objective.
Other data suggest that there may be more slack in labor markets than indicated by the unemployment rate.
At present, I rate the chances of this happening as significantly below the chances of inflation persisting below 2 percent
This approach underscores the continuing commitment of the FOMC to maintain the appropriate degree of accommodation to support the recovery.
economic conditions may, for some time, warrant keeping short-term interest rates below levels the Committee views as likely to prove normal in the longer run.
the FOMC stands ready to adjust the pace of purchases as warranted should the outlook change materially.

parsed.rationale: The speaker stresses substantial remaining labor slack, inflation well below 2 percent with downside risks outweighing upside, and a commitment to prolonged accommodation and low rates even after liftoff. Taper continuation is described neutrally, so the net signal is moderately dovish.
